summary: Pool member joined_at is carried from the pool version through persona_pool_publisher, build_portfolio_envelope (optional, checksummed, schema-validated), paper_signal_producer portfolio_member_views into MemberVirtualBooks admitted_at (recorded once, never rewritten). Envelopes already running without joined_at are reached by one automatic paper republish per persona on the existing governed path (operator path A, 2026-11-26).

1_carry.path: pool version member.joined_at -> PersonaPoolPublisher._build_envelope (envelope member joined_at + publish-record pin joined_at) -> build_portfolio_envelope (inside checksummed strategy_logic.members) -> strategy_artifact.schema.json (joined_at optional date-time, additionalProperties false kept) -> paper_signal_producer portfolio_member_views -> MemberVirtualBooks.observe admitted_at
1_carry.back_compat: An envelope without joined_at still validates (test_envelope_published_before_the_carry_stays_valid_and_records_no_admission, test_portfolio_envelope).

2_book_records_once.detail: A book with admitted_at null records the first carried joined_at once; a recorded admitted_at is never changed; since_inception keeps ADMISSION_FIRST_MARK_GRACE_DAYS (test_member_virtual_book).

3_running_envelopes.path_used: Path A (operator decision 2026-11-26): one automatic paper republish per persona through the existing cycle -> BFF publish route -> PersonaPoolPublisher -> coordinator -> Governance (automated paper gate) -> DeploymentPlan -> RuntimeBinding replace. Path B (runtime reading the persona owner) was not built: no new principal, secret, compose change or runtime read.
3_running_envelopes.why_it_reaches_running_bindings: The publish record pins of every envelope published before this release have no joined_at. pool_policy.publication_change now reports envelope_member_admission_missing:<ref> when a running pin lacks joined_at or differs from the pool member, never as a membership change. The daily pool cycle (_publish) therefore publishes the persona's current pool version through the unchanged publisher, whose new envelope carries joined_at; the RuntimeBinding moves to it by the existing replace saga, so the runtime's next member views carry joined_at into the book. No manual hosted write.
3_running_envelopes.newer_than_running_rule: The publisher still refuses a pool version that is not newer than the running envelope. When the current pool version is not newer than the last confirmed publication and the only reasons are envelope_member_admission_missing, the cycle asks the owner (PersonaStrategyPoolStore.append_envelope_republish) to append exactly one version whose members are identical to the current one, decision.action=envelope_republish, status=republished, change_reason 'envelope republish of pool vN membership unchanged; carries member joined_at into the running envelope'. It is appended without policy authorization, so membership/weight validation is the strictest record path; it is not a reweight and carries no persona_trial_count. On hosted the refused reweights of 2026-11-25 already appended pool version 7, so if the running envelopes pin an older pool version the cycle publishes v7 and appends nothing.
3_running_envelopes.once_per_persona: After the republish the record pins carry joined_at, so the trigger is false on the next cycle (test_running_envelope_without_joined_at_republishes_once_with_one_new_version: two cycles, one republish, one new version; chain test step 5). A failed publish is retried without a second version (test_failed_republish_is_retried_without_a_second_version).
3_running_envelopes.membership_stage_weights: Unchanged. No reweight and no admission happen through this path; no envelope_publication consultation is opened because membership does not change.

tests: services/control-plane/bff/test_persona_pool_publisher.py::test_running_envelope_without_joined_at_is_republished_once_and_reaches_the_book (running envelope without joined_at -> cycle publish step via HttpPoolCyclePorts -> real BFF route -> publisher -> coordinator -> new envelope with joined_at -> producer member views -> book admitted_at; second cycle unchanged). Verified to fail with status unchanged when publication_change lacks the admission reason.

5_release_probe.behaviour: Viewer dev-login like persona-pool-member-rules; reads /bff/version build_time and every live persona detail (paged). Fails when a current member book whose newest mark (book.as_of / underlyings[].as_of) is later than the BFF build time has admitted_at different from the member's joined_at; exits 77 with no_member_book_marked_after_bff_build when no such book exists; an unknown build_time fails with bff_build_time_unknown. Test uses the hosted detail shape of 2026-11-26 (persona-ee7112a829d38b9135ac, joined_at 2026-11-08T18:10:02Z, admitted_at null, marks 2026-11-19..2026-11-24).
5_release_probe.hosted_build_time_source: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh exports BUILD_TIME; app_factory /bff/version returns it as build_time.

6_runtime_budget.detail: No new writer. At most one extra pool version and one envelope per trading persona in total (3 on hosted), then none. Each member book gains one admitted_at value. Observations stay one row per member per trading session (MemberVirtualBooks.observe unchanged apart from the admitted_at fill).

changed_assertions.change: Fixture pins() now writes joined_at on each pin by default (and live_pool uses the same JOINED constant). No assertion changed.
changed_assertions.justification: pins() stands for a publish record; records written by the publisher since 6cc27c784 carry joined_at. Without it every existing publish test would also see envelope_member_admission_missing, which is the pre-release case now covered by explicit new tests (joined=None).

governance.question: Does the republish need a governance approval on hosted?
governance.answer: No new approval. PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.publish_pool_envelope uses the same automated paper-scope Governance decision as admission (actor_role automated_gate, asserted in the chain test). The envelope_publication risk-panel consultation applies only to a live membership change, and this republish never changes membership. Stage is paper only; the publisher refuses any other stage. There is no step the cycle cannot pass on paper, so nothing is bypassed and no blocker is raised.

known_limits: The three hosted members stay since_inception false after admitted_at is recorded, because their books start 2026-11-19, 11 days after admission; MEMBER-BOOK-ADMISSION-GAP-FILL-20261126 owns that gap.
Acceptance 3 completes on hosted only after this release is deployed and the next daily pool cycle runs; the probe judges books marked after the BFF build.
